Slop Upscale · Beta

Image and video upscaler

Bigger pictures and short videos, with AI that runs on your device.

Open now

Slop Upscale has these main features: 2× and 4×, Fast (bundled) or Quality (Real-ESRGAN); Tiled with progress and cancel. It opens Any image, Video.

Beta: still being tested, so some parts may change.

What you can do with Slop Upscale

  • Upscale an image 2× or 4×
  • Upscale a short video
